description: This is a Java test class for the ChewbaccaUncaughtExceptionHandler, containing unit tests for crash handling and notification logic within the Chewbacca module of the app.

classes.name: ChewbaccaUncaughtExceptionHandlerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ChewbaccaUncaughtExceptionHandler, testing crash detection, notification, and report generation.

classes.name: TestableChewbaccaUncaughtExceptionHandler
classes.description: A subclass of ChewbaccaUncaughtExceptionHandler used for testing, overriding methods to provide controlled behavior during tests.

methods.name: testCallsPreviousHandler
methods.description: Verifies that the handler correctly calls the previous uncaught exception handler.

methods.name: testDoesNotCrashOnNullPreviousHandler
methods.description: Ensures that the handler does not crash when no previous handler is set.

methods.name: testDoesNotCreateArchivedReportIfNotCrashed
methods.description: Checks that no crash report is created if the app has not crashed.

methods.name: testCallsDetectedIfPreviouslyCrashed
methods.description: Simulates a crash report and verifies that the crash detection flow processes it correctly, including notification and report validation.

methods.name: testCrashLogFileWasCreated
methods.description: Ensures that a crash log file is created upon an uncaught exception and contains expected content.
